TrustedOrigins_Comment: The origins this site trusts: its own address, which the waitlist emails, the sitemap and the download QR code link to. List it here, since the Host header is the client's to write and any address not listed gets a 400.

ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHeaders_Comment: These values apply only if your backend is hosted behind a CDN (such as `Cloudflare`).
ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHostHeaderName_Comment: For Cloudflare, use X-Host instead of X-Forwarded-Host.
ForwardedHeaders.KnownIPNetworks_Comment: CIDR ranges of the proxies allowed to tell this app who the client is - a request from the public internet can never carry one of these addresses. Loopback covers a proxy on the same host; the ranges above cover one running beside the app, such as a cloudflared tunnel or an Aspire, Docker Compose or Kubernetes sidecar. Behind Cloudflare, use a Cloudflare Tunnel: the origin then needs no inbound port at all - close 80 and 443 to the internet - and the visitor's real ip arrives with the request. On an intranet deployment, where the clients themselves sit in these ranges, empty this out.

ConnectionStrings.smtp_Comment: Endpoint=smtp://host:port;UserName=...;Password=... The same format as the app's server. With none, emails are logged instead of sent.

AI.ChatOptions_Comment: Configures Temperature, TopP, TopK and the rest of the properties of Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ChatOptions. Temperature null leaves the model its own default: a reasoning model refuses any other, so set a number only while Reasoning:Effort is None. Over /v1/responses, MaxOutputTokens counts what the model reasons too. Reasoning:Output Summary shows the chat what the model reasoned.

OpenAI.ChatUseResponsesApi_Comment: The same setting as the app's server: /v1/responses, where the model can call tools while it reasons. false for a provider with only /v1/chat/completions, such as Google AI Studio, and then set AI:ChatOptions:Reasoning:Effort to None.
OpenAI.ChatApiKey_Comment: The same setting as the app's server, and the same user secrets, so one key serves both. With none, the chat streams a sample answer.
